note: Primary source: gt_results/arvo_21176/vulnerable-instrumentation.patch, Stage 04's actual diff against the real vulnerable ares_parse_soa_reply.c that inserted the ASSERT_EVT fprintf markers. All three markers print the identical argument `(unsigned long)rr_name` -- ares_parse_soa_reply's function-scope `char *rr_name` pointer -- so all four distinct $event.field placeholders found across the 'required'/'transition' assertions in verified_assertions.json (bare 'rr_name_ptr' in a-root-null-reset; 'loop_top.rr_name_ptr' and 'end_iter_free.rr_name_ptr' in a-dangling-persist; 'loop_top.rr_name_ptr' and 'error_free.rr_name_ptr' in a-stale-to-sink) resolve to the SAME literal source expression 'rr_name'. The distinct event names denote *when* rr_name is read, not a different expression -- this identity-across-time is exactly the bug's mechanism (a stale pointer value persisting unreset). Per-event insertion points, confirmed against the patch's unified-diff line numbers and cross-checked one-for-one against ground_truth.json: 'loop_top' fprintf sits immediately before original line 88 (`status = ares__expand_name_for_response(...)`, = ground_truth.source.line) so it captures rr_name carried over from the prior iteration (or NULL on i=0); 'error_free' fprintf sits immediately before original line 91 (`ares_free(rr_name)` in the failed-expansion handler, = ground_truth.sink.line); 'end_iter_free' fprintf sits immediately before original line 164 (`ares_free(rr_name)` at a successful non-SOA iteration's end, = ground_truth.root_cause.line). Numeric cross-validation: vulnerable_assertion_trace.txt shows loop_top rr_name_ptr=0x0 (iteration=0) -> end_iter_free rr_name_ptr=0x6020000001f0 -> loop_top rr_name_ptr=0x6020000001f0 (iteration=1) -> error_free rr_name_ptr=0x6020000001f0, i.e. the same non-NULL pointer value read at end_iter_free persists unchanged through the next loop_top and into error_free -- exactly what a-dangling-persist and a-stale-to-sink assert (eq checks in verified_assertions.json) and exactly what assertion_results.json's matrix encodes numerically (105690555220464 == 0x6020000001f0 in every non-zero cell). fixed_assertion_trace.txt confirms the fix: loop_top/error_free read back 0x0 in iteration 1 because patch.diff inserts 'rr_name = NULL;' at the top of each loop iteration (a '+'-only line, correctly not used as a vulnerable-version binding). No fields omitted: all 4 distinct $event.field placeholders resolved with high confidence directly from Stage 04's own instrumentation diff, not guessed from ground_truth.json prose.
